title: CDev exec_settings.json
description: Per-project execution settings for the CDev editor. Values may be platform specific: {"windows": "...", "linux": "...", "darwin": "...", "default": "..."}. Commands support variables like ${file}, ${outFile}, ${projectDir} and every tool name, e.g. ${gcc}.

command.description: Shell command (string), list of commands run in sequence, or platform specific object. Variables: ${file} ${fileRel} ${fileDir} ${fileName} ${fileBase} ${fileExt} ${outDir} ${outFile} ${projectDir} ${toolsDir} ${tmpDir} ${runnerDir} ${exe} ${env:NAME} and every tool, e.g. ${gcc}. Use ${raw:name} to skip automatic quoting.

requires.description: Glob(s) relative to the project that must exist for this entry to apply, e.g. "Cargo.toml"

tools.description: Tools this language uses (for the New-project wizard)

check.description: Command that prints compiler-style diagnostics (file:line:col: error: msg) for live error checking

setup.description: One-time setup, e.g. create a venv

checkOnSaved.description: Run the check on the saved file instead of a temporary copy (needed for multi-file project tools like cargo)

preview.description: Show in the browser preview instead of running

browserRuntime.description: Fallback runtime in the browser when no runner is connected

pathMode.description: How the wizard wrote tool paths. Relative paths are resolved from this file's folder.

inheritDefaults.description: Merge with CDev's built-in defaults (false = only what is in this file)

toolsDir.description: Folder with portable tools, available as ${toolsDir}

path.description: Folders prepended to PATH (relative to the project). Folders of absolute tool paths are added automatically.

tools.description: Tool name -> executable. Bare names use PATH; paths may be relative (to this file) or absolute.
